Agent 35/35 — adversarial handling integrator/red team. Audit the current Digital Driver V2 plus tire/chassis/drivetrain stack and try to falsify the claim that the biggest cornering pain point is now solved. Use existing deterministic tests and propose additional scenarios. Rank remaining defects by player impact, physical plausibility, confidence, regression risk and implementation cost. Do not make broad tuning changes. If one small root-cause patch is overwhelmingly justified, propose it with evidence; otherwise return a prioritized integration plan.
